payload.prompt: string, <=20000 UTF-16 code units; retained byte-for-byte when no fragment
payload.tools: optional plain object: angle, lighting, camera only

result.sections: ordered array of {tool,label,text}; text is exact rendered line
result.applied_tools: ordered array of nonempty tool names

lighting.color: empty or #RGB/#RRGGBB; active #000/#000000 rejects (use brightness to darken)
lighting.lightYaw: optional finite number -360000..360000; do not fill default0 if omitted
lighting.smartText: string <=1000 UTF-16 code units; trim only this free-text field

rules: Three groups explicitly default OFF, including omitted enabled. Validate known fields/types/enums/ranges without coercion. Unknown payload/group/field keys fail clearly; no echo of invalid values. enabled is boolean only. Missing group/empty group is allowed. Other optional numeric fields cannot be null; only focal allows null.

Use source builder vocabulary and numeric:true angle semantics. Use JS Math.round semantics (floor(x+0.5)), never Python bankers rounding. Whole-number formatting must have no .0. Directional angle presets ignore yaw/pitch; fisheye/dutch add slider fragments.

Light continuous coordinates take precedence over legacy keyLight if EITHER numeric coordinate is present. Both omitted => use legacy keyLight. Zero/zero continuous is neutral, NOT frontal-light injection. Color empty means unspecified, never inject default white.

Ordering is angle(Camera), lighting(Lighting), camera(Lens). Generate lines use LABEL: fragment. Edit lines use exact source imperative wrappers, followed by the explicit preservation guard below only if at least one section exists.

Preserve the original prompt exactly, including whitespace. If sections exist join original prompt (if nonempty), blank line, then section lines. If original prompt is empty return section lines only. No newlines or guard when sections are empty.
Returned sections contain rendered labeled/imperative lines, without the preservation guard. applied_tools uses only nonempty fragments, not merely enabled groups.

Final prompt length<=20000, finite numbers only (booleans are not numbers). Invalid mode/settings/overlong final prompt must stop before inference. Native UI may constrain/snaps/preview angles, but compiler rejects out-of-range pitch rather than silently clamping.

AI direction only. These controls do not set real camera matrices, EXIF, physical light simulation, or vendor API fields. Only composed prompt is passed to existing inference routes; model, references and explicit API options are not overwritten. Compiler makes zero network/file/credential calls.

Composing/previewing/applying/resetting controls never submits generation or creates a paid task. Preview compiler and host compiler must agree. Host recomputes from typed controls and rejects client-forged final prompt.
edit_guard: Preserve all subject and scene details that are not explicitly requested to change.

directionalPresets.front_high: front view, high-angle shot, looking down at the subject
directionalPresets.front_low: front view, low-angle shot, looking up from below
directionalPresets.aerial_top_down: aerial view, bird's-eye view, top-down shot

lensPresets.fisheye: fisheye lens, distorted spherical wide-angle perspective

yawSectors: three-quarter front view, from the right
three-quarter back view, from the right
three-quarter back view, from the left
three-quarter front view, from the left

shots.long: long shot, full body in frame
shots.medium: medium shot, from the waist up

presets.overexposedFilm: overexposed film look, blown-out highlights, dreamy soft glow
presets.blueBacklight: blue backlighting, cool blue rim light, glowing silhouette edges
presets.rembrandt: Rembrandt lighting, key light at 45 degrees, triangle of light on the shadow-side cheek, chiaroscuro
presets.cyberpunk: cyberpunk lighting, neon pink and cyan light sources, high-contrast neon rim lighting
presets.psychedelicSunset: psychedelic sunset lighting, saturated magenta and orange glow, low sun backlight
presets.mysteriousDark: low-key lighting, deep dramatic shadows, mysterious moody atmosphere
presets.goldenHour: golden hour lighting, warm soft low-angle sunlight, long shadows
presets.nolanGray: cool desaturated color grade, muted teal and slate gray tones, soft overcast cinematic light

keyLights.left: key light from camera left, dramatic side lighting
keyLights.right: key light from camera right, dramatic side lighting
